|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Use The Force (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). No published image shows the errata text; [[Use The Force (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-04-Use_The_Force-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = number of cards stacked on Communing: Peek at the top card of any deck or pile; may then shuffle it. OR Draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. OR Retrieve 1 Force. OR Activate X Force. OR Your next destiny draw this turn is +X.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 37) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Use The Force (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Use The Force (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “where X = number” to “where X = the number”, “pile; may then shuffle” to “pile: may then shuffle”, “this turn is +X” to “is + X” and set the options in lower case (“peek”, “draw 2 cards from reserve deck”, “retrieve 1 force”, “activate X force”, “your next destiny”): “Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = the number of cards stacked on Communing: peek at the top card of any deck or pile: may then shuffle it. OR draw 2 cards from reserve deck. OR retrieve 1 force. OR activate X force. OR your next destiny draw is + X.”.<ref name="cl-1273_34-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
